title: A1
query: What is the functional domain associated with EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE toLower(p.hasPrimaryName) = 'egfr' RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName AS functionalDomainName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName AS functionalDomainName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A2
query: What are the amino acid changes and mutation descriptions for EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN (m.hasWildTypeResidue + toString(m.hasStartLocation) + m.hasPKAResidue) AS amino_acid_change,        m.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description UNION ALL MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(om:OtherMutation) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN om.hasMutationAA AS amino_acid_change,        om.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN m.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description,        (m.hasWildTypeResidue + m.hasMutantType) AS amino_acid_change UNION ALL MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(om:OtherMutation) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN om.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description,        om.hasMutationAA AS amino_acid_change
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN m.aminoAcidChange AS amino_acid_change, m.description AS description LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName:'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN coalesce(m.hasMutationAA, m.hasWildTypeResidue + '->' + m.hasPKAResidue) AS amino_acid_change, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description LIMIT 100

ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK1'})-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName AS Organism;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (protein:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK1'})-[:PRESENTIN]->(organism:Organism) RETURN organism.hasPrimaryName AS organismName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK1'})-[r:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName AS Organism LIMIT 100

title: C7
query: Find pathways that include proteins containing the functional domain 'PI3_PI4_kinase' and have mutations. Please provide the names of these pathways and descriptions of the mutations.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mut) WHERE mut.hasMutationDescription IS NOT NULL RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS PathwayName, mut.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (pathway:Pathway)<-[:PARTICIPATESIN]-(protein:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) MATCH (protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mutation) WHERE any(label IN labels(mutation) WHERE label IN ['Missense', 'OtherMutation', 'CodingSilent', 'Nonsense', 'DeletionFrameshift', 'InsertionInframe', 'InsertionFrameshift', 'DeletionInframe', 'ComplexDeletionInframe', 'ComplexFrameshift', 'CompoundSubstitution', 'ComplexInsertionInframe']) RETURN pathway.hasPrimaryName AS pathwayName, collect(DISTINCT mutation.hasMutationDescription) AS mutationDescriptions
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(p:Pathway),       (prot)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}),       (prot)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mut) WHERE any(label IN labels(mut) WHERE label IN ['Missense', 'Deletion', 'CodingSilent', 'Nonsense', 'Insertion',                                                   'DeletionFrameshift', 'InsertionInframe', 'OtherMutation', 'DeletionInframe',                                                   'InsertionFrameshift', 'ComplexDeletionInframe', 'ComplexFrameshift',                                                   'CompoundSubstitution', 'ComplexInsertionInframe']) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS PathwayName, mut.hasPrimaryName AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'})<-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]-(protein:Protein) MATCH (protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) MATCH (protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mutation) RETURN DISTINCT pathway.hasPrimaryName AS pathway_name,        COALESCE(mutation.hasMutationDescription, 'Mutation: ' + head(labels(mutation))) AS mutation_description LIMIT 100

query: List the organisms that have proteins containing the functional domain 'Cadherin'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (o:Organism)<-[:PRESENTIN]-(p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Cadherin' RETURN o.hasPrimaryName AS organismName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (o:Organism)<-[:PRESENTIN]-(p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'Cadherin'}) RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName AS Organism
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Cadherin' MATCH (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName AS Organism LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'Cadherin'}) MATCH (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName AS organism LIMIT 100

title: C9
query: Which mutations of the protein 'BRAF' associated with samples implicated in 'carcinoma_blastoma'? Please provide the mutation IDs and mutation descriptions.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(mut) WHERE mut:Missense OR mut:OtherMutation WITH mut MATCH (mut)-[:INSAMPLE]->(sample:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(cancer:Cancer {hasPrimaryName: 'carcinoma_blastoma'}) RETURN DISTINCT mut.hasMutationId AS mutationId, mut.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(mutation) MATCH (mutation)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer {hasPrimaryName: 'carcinoma_blastoma'}) RETURN mutation.hasMutationId AS mutationId, mutation.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (protein:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mutation)-[:INSAMPLE]->(sample:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(cancer:Cancer) WHERE protein.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF' AND cancer.hasPrimaryName = 'carcinoma_blastoma' RETURN mutation.hasPrimaryName AS mutationID, mutation.description AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) WHERE m:Missense OR m:OtherMutation MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer {hasPrimaryName: 'carcinoma_blastoma'}) RETURN m.hasMutationId AS MutationID, m.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100

title: C10
query: What are the reactions associated with pathways in which BRAF protein participates?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway)-[:HASREACTION]->(reaction:Reaction) RETURN reaction.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway)-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF' RETURN DISTINCT r.hasPrimaryName AS reactionName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(path:Pathway)-[:HASREACTION]->(rxn:Reaction) RETURN DISTINCT rxn.hasPrimaryName AS Reaction LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (braf:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway)-[:HASREACTION]->(reaction:Reaction) RETURN DISTINCT reaction.hasPrimaryName AS ReactionName LIMIT 100
